description: Fork of exp108 trading nap for tph: nap 10 -> 8 (table_dim 1024 -> 256, 4x smaller per-table), tph multiplied by 4 (qk/v 768 -> 3072, out 4096 -> 16384). Per-layer LUT weight count unchanged (qk/v: 6*3072*256*1=4.72M, out: 1*16384*256*1=4.19M). Same n_sparse_outputs=1 scalar regime, balanced coverage. Tables/output: qk/v 3072/64=48 exact, out_proj 16384/384=42.67 (256 slots get 43, 128 slots get 42).
